aboutMe.subtitle: Who I am
aboutMe.title: About me
aboutMe.intro: Hi, I’m Dani. As a frontend developer and certified tax advisor with a research background, I’m fascinated by the intersection of tax law, education and technology. My Playground: TaxTech & EdTech.
aboutMe.residence: I’m based in the western part of Duisburg and open to project-based collaboration, both regionally and remotely.
aboutMe.openness: My interest in continuous learning drives me to explore new technologies and use them to develop suitable solutions for concrete challenges.
aboutMe.improve: I enjoy working through complex questions step by step, value collaboration, and see every project as an opportunity to improve.

skills.subtitle: Technologies
skills.title: Skill Set
skills.stack: My experience includes research projects involving microsimulation and optimization models, as well as Serious Games and gamified learning formats. My frontend work focuses on web-based development, with a particular focus on Angular and TypeScript.
skills.contact: Feel free to get in touch. I’m open to expanding my tech stack, such as Python or C#, depending on project needs.
